## About
B & M Auto Collision Center is owned and operated by Bogdan (Bob) Trytko. The shop specializes in auto body repair, auto body paint and writing estimates, with mechanical repair under the same roof.
Repairs are done by I-CAR certified technicians using on-site laser alignment, frame laser measurement and spot welding. Paint work follows industry standards: surface prep, primer, paint and finish coats, cured in full downdraft baking paint booths. The goal is a vehicle restored to pre-accident condition.
You'll find us at W Addison St, just west of Milwaukee in the Old Irving Park neighborhood, north of Logan Square and south of Albany Park. We hold a 4.2 Google rating from 230 reviews.

## Services
- Auto Body Repair: Damaged panels and structure repaired by I-CAR certified technicians, using laser frame measurement and spot welding, so the vehicle is restored to pre-accident condition.
- Auto Body Paint: Surface prep, primer, paint and finish coats applied to industry standards, cured in full downdraft baking paint booths.
- Mechanical Repair: Our mechanics diagnose the problem and make the appropriate repair.
- Estimates: Our estimators work to make the estimate represent the actual cost of the repair work. Estimates are free. Make an appointment at your convenience.
- Towing: We've teamed with A AllStar Towing so you can get your car brought to the shop after an accident, any time of day.
- Rental Cars: We have a long standing relationship with Enterprise Rent-A-Car and can arrange a rental car for you while your car is in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all standard insurance companies. We are also a preferred auto repair shop by major insurance companies as part of their Direct Repair Program.

Q: Do I need to get more than one estimate?
A: No. As a preferred auto body repair shop, there is no need to get multiple estimates.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: On W Addison St, just west of Milwaukee in the Old Irving Park neighborhood, north of Logan Square and south of Albany Park.
